title: Close an E-Toll Account
summary: This page explains how to permanently close your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account.
intro:
If you want to permanently close your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account, you can do so at a Service NSW Centre.

You'll need to pay any outstanding fees when closing the account.

If you're closing an E-Toll Account on behalf of another person, you'll need to provide a letter signed by the account holder authorising you to do so, including details about the closure.

### Moving interstate

If you no longer live in NSW you can return your tag by registered post, with an accompanying letter advising that the tag is no longer required.

Refunds can be paid either to your nominated credit or debit card, or by cheque if your account refills are paid by direct debit from a bank account. Your refund will be processed after 31 days.
who_can_apply: Must pay any outstanding fees when closing the account.
If closing on behalf of another person, a letter signed by the account holder authorising the closure is required.
what_you_need: Your tag (for an E-Toll Tag Account)
The ABN or ACN (if the account is a corporate/business account)
A letter authorising you to close the account, signed by the account holder (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: pay any outstanding amounts on your account
send your tag(s) with your explanatory letter and the required information, by registered mail to:E-Toll Business Operations CentrePO Box 1447Parramatta NSW 2124
If the package is lost in transit you may be charged a non-return tag fee.
Returning your tag by registered mail means your package can be tracked.
